scripts.build: npm run check-types && npm run test && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-core && npm run build --workspace synthex-ui && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-react-web && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-cli && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/web-preview
scripts.build:web-preview:ci: npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-core && npm run build --workspace synthex-ui && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-react-web && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/web-preview
scripts.check-types: npm run typecheck --workspace @luseefor/synthex-core && npm run typecheck --workspace synthex-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @luseefor/synthex-react-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @luseefor/synthex-cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @luseefor/web-preview
